meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation review orchestrator. Launches 5 parallel background sub-agents: Oracle (goal/constraint verification), Oracle (code quality), Oracle (security), unspecified-high (hands-on QA execution), unspecified-high (context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion). All must pass for review to pass. MUST USE before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. Triggers: 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', 'check my work', 'validate changes', 'post-implementation review'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行发起多路审查，把关已完成工作质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在交接已完工作前需要多路审查把关。
copy.tagline_en: Launch parallel review agents to validate completed work before handoff.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need parallel review agents to check your completed work before handoff.

howto.what: 工作完成后请你评审，它会并行派出5个后台子代理：核对目标是否达到、检查代码质量、审计安全性、实际运行做QA，并从GitHub、git、Slack、Notion等寻找遗漏上下文。5项全部通过才算通过，任一项失败则整体失败。
howto.when: 在PR交接前，或你明确要求评审已完成工作时发出“review my work”“QA my work”“check my work”等指令，即会启动。

say.text: 帮我review一下刚才的改动，看看有没有偏离需求。
say.note: 触发目标与约束核对代理。

say.text: QA我新做的功能，跑起来实测一下。
say.note: 由QA代理实际运行应用验证。

say.text: PR前评审我的工作，顺便查安全和代码质量。
say.note: 同时启动安全与代码审查代理。

howto.what_en: On review requests, it launches 5 parallel background sub-agents: goal check, code quality, security audit, hands-on QA, and context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion. All must pass; any single failure fails the review.
howto.when_en: It takes over before a PR handoff or when you explicitly ask to review completed work, e.g. saying 'review my work', 'QA my work', or 'check my work'.

say_en.text: Review my recent changes and check if they meet the requirements.
QA the feature I just built by running it.
say_en.note: A QA agent executes the app hands-on.

say_en.text: Review my work before the PR, including security and code quality.
say_en.note: Spins up security and code-review lanes.
